evidence.excerpt:
End-to-end research agents can now produce
complete scientific papers, yet manuscript
claims often diverge from executed experi-
ments. This gap is structural: research state,
failure histories, and claim–evidence align-
ment are not maintained as persistent, verifi-
able state across long-horizon pipelines. We
presentYouRA (Your Research Agent), an
architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable au-
tonomous research. YouRA preserves research
state, execution evidence, and failure history
across the research trajectory by integrating
three components: aVerification State Architec-
ture(VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and
evidence pointers; anIndependent Controller
that turns state and reflection records into lifecy-
cle, recovery, and debate/review control while
separating control from execution; andState-
ful Reflectionthat logs failures as structured
lessons and routes recovery

YouRA's first component targets context and evi-
dence fragmentation. In conventional agent loops,
state is implicitly embedded in conversation his-
tory, where it is vulnerable to truncation and hallu-
cination. YouRA instead maintains research state
through a Y AML-basedVerification State Architec-
ture (VSA). A central verification_state.yaml
tracks macro pipeline state (hypotheses, gate re-
sults, routing decisions, evidence pointers, and a
failed-hypotheses registry), and per-stage check-
point files complement it. Later stages read gate
outcomes, evidence pointers, and failure records
from the VSA, so executed experiments become

evidence.excerpt:
YouRA's second component turns persistent state
into control. The VSA stores the research trajec-
tory, and Stateful Reflection records failure con-
straints and routing history; the independent con-
troller consumes these records to choose the next
action. Concretely, the controller supports three
roles:lifecycle continuation, selecting the next
stage from VSA gate status;recovery escalation,
consuming Stateful Reflection records to choose
repair, redesign, or reset boundaries; andindepen-
dent debate/review, used by Hypothesis Debate
and Adversarial Fact Review. By keeping control
in a separate context from task execution, YouRA
avoids making the execution conversation itself the
only source of control state. The controller there-
fore reads compact VSA/artifact summaries rather
than the full trace and emits continuation context
at stop or human-in-the-loop boundaries.

evidence.excerpt:
YouRA's third component,Stateful Reflection,
turns failure signals into structured constraints that
later stages can use. It operates over Reflective
Memory (§3.2) during the hypothesis loop: routing-
relevant outcomes are recorded with structured rea-
sons, supporting or refuting evidence, and pivot-
or-reuse rationales, so refuted approaches become
negative constraints while validated and partially
validated components become reusable evidence
for successor stages. Recovery proceeds in three
levels. Bounded repair first handles local Cod-
ing & Validation failures, and after each execution
an independent mock-data and hard-coded-result
detector checks whether reported outputs are de-
rived from actual data processing; detected fab-
rications trigger repair before evidence is passed
downstream. If a MUST_WORK gate remains unsat-
isfied after repair, Stateful Reflection escalates

End-to-end scoring on the ten-task subset averages
four frontier-class judges from distinct model fam-
ilies (Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google DeepMind, 2026),
GPT 5.4 (OpenAI, 2026), Grok 4.3 (xAI, 2026),
and Opus 4.6 (Anthropic, 2026a)), selected so
that judge capability meets or exceeds that of the
generators under evaluation while limiting judge–
generator overlap. Pairwise win rates use the same
four judges with order-bias control: for each pa-
per pair, we evaluate both presentation orders and
count the comparison as a tie if the preferred paper
changes when the order is reversed. All evaluations
run fully autonomously.

All experiments focus on machine learning and
Deep learning tasks, leaving the applicability of
YouRA to other scientific domains for future in-
vestigation. Research quality is assessed using the
MLR-Judge framework with a judge LLM different
from those evaluated in the original MLR-Bench
study. Alignment with human reviewers therefore
requires separate validation for our judge config-
uration. Input truncation due to the judge LLMs'
context length limits may disadvantage papers with
extensive code, result files, or logs. The systems
compared in our experiments operate with differ-
ent tool configurations and token budgets, so the
reported scores reflect performance under each sys-
tem's resource conditions. A promising direction
for future work is to develop a benchmark with
standardized tool access and token budgets, provid-
ing a common experimental setting for comparing

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Human validation of automated hallucination flags and independent dual-analyzer provenance classification corroborate the reported performance trends.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: The headline outcome is established by an external four-judge LLM panel using MLR-Bench rubrics, with human validation of hallucination flags and dual-analyzer data-provenance classification.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The system under study is shaped by internal gate tests, mock-data/hard-coded-result detectors, and reflection-guided recovery routing within the Coding and Validation loop.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported improvements in Overall, Soundness, and Significance over MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 are well corroborated across backbones, with clear ablation evidence confirming the performance drop when persistent state or independent control is removed.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation on the 10-task MLR-Bench subset uses a panel of four distinct frontier LLM judges with position-bias-controlled pairwise scoring across three backbones, supported by component ablations, human validation of hallucination diagnostics, and dual-model data-provenance analyses.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Human validation of flagged hallucination instances (Cohen's kappa 0.54, 75.2% precision) and automated dual-analyzer code/data provenance classification corroborate the performance trends.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Final evaluation relies on external MLR-Judge evaluations from an independent four-judge frontier model panel across five rubric criteria, paired human verification of hallucinations, and external data-provenance scripts.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: System execution is driven by gate tests in the Coding and Validation loop, mock-data detectors, and internal reflection heuristics.

primary.limitations: The study openly notes constraints including evaluation limited to machine learning domains, context truncation during LLM judging of long code/logs, and differing baseline tool environments and token budgets.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing YAML-based state representations, decoupled controller loops (GPT-5.2), staged transitions across 10 lifecycle phases, failure escalation logic (repair, redesign, reset), and tool integration via MCP.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a substantial and clear architectural contribution to autonomous scientific discovery agents, with thorough experimental controls, rigorous ablation studies, and independent multi-judge corroboration paired with human audit.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces YouRA, an autonomous research agent architecture featuring a Verification State Architecture (VSA) for persistent state management, an independent controller decoupled from task execution, and stateful reflection for multi-level failure recovery.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a substantial and clear architectural contribution to autonomous scientific discovery agents, with thorough experimental controls, rigorous ablation studies, and independent multi-judge corroboration paired with human audit.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The study openly notes constraints including evaluation limited to machine learning domains, context truncation during LLM judging of long code/logs, and differing baseline tool environments and token budgets.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
